status: current capability-tier defaults; review when product capabilities or repo evidence change

supervisor.escalation_triggers: Ambiguous recovery, source authority, publication safety, or H2/H3 architecture.
supervisor.deescalation_triggers: Bounded H0/H1 implementation with stable contracts.
supervisor.output_contract: One-work-order Implementation report with exact publication and runway state.
supervisor.tool_permission_posture: Owns integrated mutation, validation, Git, and publication.

planner.escalation_triggers: Broad candidate-supply scarcity or conflicting portfolio evidence.
planner.deescalation_triggers: Packet freshness scan or obvious no-op.
planner.output_contract: Non-authoritative current-configurator candidate packet or NO_MATERIAL_PORTFOLIO_UPDATE.
planner.tool_permission_posture: Read-heavy; material output only on planning/portfolio-*; never queue authority.

curator.escalation_triggers: Preauthorization invalidation, source authority, or global evidence wait is ambiguous.
curator.deescalation_triggers: Healthy runway and no material curation event.
curator.output_contract: Independent candidate dispositions and canonical Ready/Preauthorized runway update.
curator.tool_permission_posture: Control-plane writer only; narrow governance tests under anti-cheating rule.

architecture_specialist.escalation_triggers: Active firmware, runtime model, critical path, or source authority is involved.
architecture_specialist.output_contract: Architecture evidence map with facts, inferences, unknowns, and recommendation.
architecture_specialist.tool_permission_posture: Read-oriented unless explicitly assigned bounded edits.

implementer.escalation_triggers: Firmware behavior risk or difficult compiler/generator logic.

validator_reviewer.default_reasoning_effort: moderate or high proportional to risk
validator_reviewer.escalation_triggers: H2/H3 behavior, generated artifacts, or publication gate.
validator_reviewer.output_contract: DONE / CONTINUE / BLOCKED / NEEDS_HARDWARE / UNSAFE with findings first.

hardware_evidence_processor.escalation_triggers: H3, identity mismatch, source drift, or ambiguous scope.
hardware_evidence_processor.deescalation_triggers: Complete exact H2 protocol with unambiguous human result.
hardware_evidence_processor.output_contract: HARDWARE_VALIDATED / HARDWARE_FAILED / HARDWARE_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH and exact disposition.
hardware_evidence_processor.tool_permission_posture: Evidence/control-plane only; never runtime source or fabricated testing.

docs_status_clerk.escalation_triggers: Canonical docs contradict source or evidence.
docs_status_clerk.deescalation_triggers: Navigation or mechanically proven status change only.

judge_watchdog.escalation_triggers: Loop, unsafe path, or hardware gate is ambiguous.
judge_watchdog.deescalation_triggers: Branch is clearly done or externally blocked.
judge_watchdog.output_contract: DONE / CONTINUE / BLOCKED / NEEDS_HARDWARE / UNSAFE / LOOPING.
